description: Occupant load, exits, aisle widths and accessible route for an Ontario retail store, with a fixture run estimate from shelving depth. Preliminary planning figure only. The architect, the fire protection engineer and the permit set govern the layout and the means of egress.

aisle_width_mm.description: Clear aisle width you plan between fixtures. Unit: mm.

door_clear_width_mm.description: Clear opening of one door leaf, 850 mm or more. Unit: mm.

fixture_depth_mm.description: Depth of one fixture run (for example a double-sided gondola). Unit: mm.

floor_area_m2.description: Retail floor area on the storey (required). Unit: m2.

store_width_m.description: Store width, to estimate the number of fixture runs. Depth is area divided by width. Unit: m.

storey.description: Storey type, which sets the area per person: first (basement or first storey, 3.70 m2), upper-entrance (second storey with principal entrance from a pedestrian thoroughfare or parking area, 3.70 m2), other (5.60 m2).

storeys.description: Building height in storeys. Unit: storeys.

travel_distance_m.description: Longest travel distance from any point to an exit. Unit: m.

name: retail_store_layout_and_aisle_width_calculator
